verdicts.decision_note: Establishes that the public mint counter must reflect successfully completed mints rather than false mint records.
First concrete failure: the public mint indicator showed mint number 4 despite no corresponding completed paid mints.
Post-correction persistence: after the contract-reading issue was addressed and corrected counters were presented for testing, the aggregate mint indicator still showed mint number 3.
Distinct contract-path failure: public statistics showed one total mint while another indicator showed mint number 4 after minting through a newly deployed contract.
